c0.name: Physically based light
c0.what: Metal and rough surfaces react to a real sun, with shadows that are cached while the camera glides.

c1.name: Dynamic resolution
c1.what: The picture is drawn at fewer pixels only when the frame rate would fall below 60; otherwise it stays sharp.

c2.name: Instant streaming
c2.what: A worker thread reads the scene while the main thread uploads a little each frame, so loading never freezes the window.

c3.name: Zero-copy frames
c3.what: The app's picture reaches the desktop compositor without a copy, so showing a window costs almost nothing.

c4.name: Touch and Joy-Con
c4.what: Sticks, buttons and the touch screen reach the app in the same frame, in a window or full screen. Try them now.

c5.name: Sound
c5.what: A mixer and resampler turn every sample format into clean stereo; this chapter plays notes made by nxn_tone.
c5.r0: mGBA at full speed, no audio dropouts

c6.name: Under the hood
c6.what: Tiled lighting, half-resolution buffers and batched draws, measured in Nexvyn Bench on the console.
